meta.title: I'm Terrified of Aging and Getting Old.
meta.description:
Don't forget to subscribe! Oh and comment OH and follow me on Instagram @8thWeekday. Could be fun. Who is to say?

25 my boy! I am 25! I was 24 and now I am not. Do I feel old? Yes. Have I felt old since I was born? Possibly. I'm afraid of aging. What if I start balding faster? What if my metabolism slows? Is this the year?! Who knows.

For one my girlfriend made it better because she gave me some cake. As in the food. Anyways though aging is a funny thing because it's scary and there is no better time to be reminded of that than on your birthday. Literally a day where everyone acknowledges the fact that you have in fact gotten older. 

ft. Taylor Stitch Winslow Park, Uniqlo pants, and a turtleneck.
